title: Browse Home and nested folders
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Explore my private folders at every depth.

**Expected behaviour** · Use one folder widget, breadcrumbs and folder routes. Graphic and label open the same folder. Give empty, missing, loading and outage states appropriate recovery.

**Scope boundary** · Use v0.1 directory listings and text reads.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-028

**Depends on** · WI-028

**Verify** · Open two levels with mouse, keyboard and tap. Verify swipe scroll, direct entry, Back and empty-folder recovery.

**Effort basis** · Contained UI and route composition.
evidence: Home and two folder levels use the same folder widget. Projects -> alpha worked by mouse and keyboard, `/folder/Projects/alpha` loaded directly after reconnect, Back restored the alpha card, Empty showed a Go up action, a missing folder showed an unavailable state with Home. Evidence: qa/sprint-2/WI-029/README.md.
